subject: QC/QA the Cloud Master content organization and structure
description:
Frank 2026-07-29: 'we need to verify and fix the organization and structure of the cloudmaster content. it needs a legit qc/qa.' Cloud Master is a DISTRIBUTION hub for multi-cloud instruction (aws/azure/openstack, possibly more). Scope: are the six children the right set and the right order; do their own pages hold real content or stubs; is the multi-cloud progression coherent (practitioner -> associate -> admin?); do the cert-prep stubs (aws-ccp, aws-developer, azure-fundamentals) actually teach or just render a path; is openstack/cloud-essentials/az-104 at parity; does the container page present them in a sensible learning order. Content QC, not mechanical -- expect real findings like the python-graphics case.
[2026-08-01 16:26] FIRST REAL FINDING, measured on production: 3 of 11 courses reachable from the Cloud Master hub; Hubs section renders 0 because the ENTIRE hubRegistry collection has one document (cloud-master itself, parent null) -- no child hubs exist. The 95 content items come from the catalog projection which buckets by TYPE not course, so a student sees 27 quizzes with no idea which course each belongs to. Not linked at all: api, az-900, clf-c02, cse, ms-102, ms-900, pl-300, server-plus. Logged BUG-079 P2. Dropped one hypothesis by measuring: server-plus and cse looked like stubs (22 links/1 file, 28 links/2 files) but every link resolves -- thin indexes over shared content, legitimate. NOT FIXED: which of the eleven are children and in what order is a curriculum call.
[2026-08-01 16:55] API SECURITY GIVEN A ROUTE (committed, not deployed). It was the 11th course and reachable from NOWHERE -- the hub-registry audit independently reported it 'surfaced on no house page and not linked by any container'. It cannot be a Cloud Master child: it is itself a container with 7 sub-hubs and nesting is capped at depth 1, which is what blocked the first deploy attempt. Added a cloud-course-card on the House of the Cloud page, same markup/classes as the four existing ones. Rendered and verified: 5 cards (was 4), api visible 720x239, target exists, tag balance unchanged. With this deployed, all 11 course directories have a route: 10 via the Cloud Master hub, api via the house page.
[2026-08-01 17:40] BUG-081 item 2 CLOSED (committed, not deployed): api-capstone registered in HubRegistry.js + firestore.rules reserved-id list. The audit caught the parity contract I would have missed -- adding the registry entry alone failed with 'reserved-id DRIFT: rules(143) vs HubRegistry(144)'. Now 0 failures, parity 144. Depth-1 re-checked (api.parent null, api-capstone childless). CAVEAT: _tools/rules-test/hub-registry-rules.test.js could NOT run -- it needs a Firestore emulator on 127.0.0.1:8181 and got ECONNREFUSED. So that harness is UNVERIFIED, not passed; only the static audit confirms parity. DEPLOY NOTE: firestore.rules changed, so this needs --only firestore:rules through the smoke-gated wrapper, not a hosting deploy.
